name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
title: Deepak Nitrite Ltd-$ - 506401 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rebounded to 18% from 11% on phenolics spreads (EBIT margin 20%), but nitric acid ran at ~45% utilisation and management guides only to Q1 beating Q4 with no numeric guidance.

utilisation.quote: we were roughly at about 45% of utilization

capex.quote: our capex includes the ability to have this in a slightly disjointed manner

triggers.label: Nitric acid utilisation ~45% in Q4
triggers.quote: we were roughly at about 45% of utilization

triggers.label: Phenolics EBIT margin 20% in Q4
triggers.quote: EBIT margins improved to 20% during Q4

triggers.label: Feedstock bought on dips, higher inventory
triggers.quote: We ended up with a much larger inventory than we would traditionally have had in Q4

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 to be better than Q4
triggers.quote: we anticipate Q1 to be better than Q4, which was, of course, better than Q3

guidance.quote: we anticipate Q1 to be better than Q4
we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26
we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028
scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27

red_flags.label: Receivable days up, shift to dealership/CSA model
red_flags.quote: we have changed the model, because today we are passing through a very volatile situation, and we do not want to risk our outstanding

red_flags.label: Realisations down in Advanced Intermediates
red_flags.quote: it was the realization which was lower as compared to earlier years

red_flags.label: Nitric acid plant technical issues, bought from market
red_flags.quote: we had to secure nitric acid from the market

evasions.quote: it's not possible for me to comment on the spreads of other companies and other countries
I continue with my position of not going into details on production numbers
No, those plants are fully operational.
